svg.text: The I Ching is read by period, not by year: ask for a
window of at most 62 days to see its character.
A mixed cell is split by the share of its rules that
support, caution or are stated as mixed.
Each line is what a named rule of one tradition
says about this period, with its source. Nobody
has tested these statements against outcomes yet.
